campaign.scope: All15 fictional objectives on three real cached road backbones with explicitly authored game grading/decks and six dry company sources; unregistered off-road ground remains closed.
campaign.capture: Only living accepted ground bodies; contested zones halt; at most3 bodies raise capture speed to1.5x; hostile ownership remains until neutralised.
campaign.pressure: Only supplied advances beyond initial ownership create lane pressure; each10 advantage-seconds costs one opponent readiness point.

initialScene.authoredChanges: Six96x130m cleared company pads,16m-wide graded game roads, explicitly rebuilt decks/culverts and two2600x45m fictional runways. WestW0/W1 moved to the actualW2-W4 component; WestW2 moved from a shareddeadend spur to the actualW1-W3 through-road; no oldgap shortcut.
initialScene.notCertified: Original street widths/bridge loads/road condition/real land use/bare-earth clearance/engineering feasibility are not surveyed. Single-valued bridge top terrain does not model under-deck traffic.

c2.purpose: Explicit legacy boundedC2 domain/air/service test scene, never the production default

hydroProof.source: Primary cached OSM body/geometry extracts; mapped polygon footprint observed, stream widths conservative game authoring.

gradingProof.method: Balanced Lipschitz cut/fill fit to planningDSM+0.5m:5% source-edge grade,2.5% at wet crossings/near-overlapping surfaces, minimum water+3m deck-vertex floor. Surface-only adjacency never adds navigation links. Explicit fictional construction, not surveyed pavement.

surfaceAdmissionProof.scope: All12 registered roads at<=5m centre intervals and5 body probes (10x4m footprint) per interval; six entire pad+grading rectangles dry, realroad entrygap<=1cm, source separations>=300m
surfaceAdmissionProof.vehicleLimitation: Native individual tank driving/turning still requires separate runtime tests. This geometry proof does not certify arbitrary chassis, road buildings or real bridge load capacity.

sampling.patches: In array order and inside each sample rectangle: d=min(x-x0,lastX-x,z-z0,lastZ-z); w=clamp(d/blendMeters,0,1); h=h*(1-w)+bilinear(patch)*w
sampling.roadbeds: After native patches: get candidates cells[floor(x/cellSize)+','+floor(z/cellSize)]; segment[ax,az,ah,bx,bz,bh,halfWidth,blend]. t=clamp(dot(point-a,b-a)/lengthSquared,0,1),d=distanceToProjection,w=clamp(1-max(0,d-halfWidth)/blend,0,1); sumW,sum(w*lerpHeight),maxW. If sumW>0 h=h*(1-maxW)+sumH/sumW*maxW. Cells contain unique ascending segment indices.
sampling.pads: After patches in array order: d=max(0,abs(x-cx)-halfX,abs(z-cz)-halfZ); w=clamp(1-d/blendMeters,0,1); h=h*(1-w)+pad.height*w
sampling.runways: After pads in array order: dx=x-cx,dz=z-cz; lateral=dx*fz-dz*fx;longitudinal=dx*fx+dz*fz;d=max(0,abs(lateral)-halfX,abs(longitudinal)-halfZ); same blend as pads
sampling.rule: Client draw mesh, vehicle Ground queries and projectile terrain contacts must use exactly this JSON and sequence; no extra client grading.
